# GUI Interface Description

## System Header Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" text with a circular icon
- **Center**: "Settings" text with a gear icon
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 23 01:03"
  - Notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Background
- Gradient background transitioning from dark purple to red-orange
- Geometric abstract design with angular shapes

## Left Sidebar Navigation
- **Search Icon**: Magnifying glass icon at the top
- **Settings Title**: "Settings" text
- **Menu Button**: Three horizontal lines icon
- **Navigation List**:
  - Network (with globe icon)
  - Bluetooth (with Bluetooth icon)
  - Background (with monitor icon)
  - Appearance (with paintbrush icon)
  - Notifications (with bell icon)
  - Search (with magnifying glass icon)
  - Multitasking (with window icon)
  - Applications (with grid icon, has right arrow)
  - Privacy (with lock icon, has right arrow)
  - Online Accounts (with cloud icon)
  - Sharing (with share icon)
  - Sound (with musical note icon)
  - Power (with power icon, highlighted in orange)
  - Displays (with monitor icon)
  - Mouse & Touchpad (with mouse icon)
  - Keyboard (with keyboard icon)
  - Printers (with printer icon)

## Main Settings Window
- **Window Title**: "Power"
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, close buttons on the top-right
- **Content Area**:
  - **Power Mode Section**:
    - Title: "Power Mode"
    - Description: "Affects system performance and power usage."
    - Options:
      - "Balanced" (selected, with orange dot indicator)
        - Description: "Standard performance and power usage."
      - "Power Saver"
        - Description: "Reduced performance and power usage."
  - **Power Saving Options Section**:
    - Title: "Power Saving Options"
    - "Screen Blank":
      - Description: "Turns the screen off after a period of inactivity."
      - Value: "Never" (with dropdown arrow)
    - "Automatic Suspend":
      - Description: "Pauses the computer after a period of inactivity."
      - Value: "Off"

## Desktop Icons
- **Left Dock**:
  - Chrome browser icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP icon
  - Files icon
  - Ubuntu Software icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Settings icon (gear)
  - Trash icon
  - App grid icon (nine dots)
- **Bottom Right Corner**:
  - "Home" folder icon with house symbol
  - "Home" text label

## Cursor
- White arrow cursor positioned near the top-right corner of the screen
